- **#2256** — Clean-break DX gate: prove onboarding from explicit composition + typed sessions — Run a clean-room onboarding exercise (fresh checkout + docs only); fix every gap until a developer can build a small app in ≤2 hours without `register_defaults`/raw projection vocabulary. Blocks #2121 (release blocker). Currently blocked by #2251–#2255. [...] - **#2256** (p1) — clean-room DX onboarding proof (fresh checkout + docs only, build a small app in ≤2h without `register_defaults`/raw projection vocabulary). Blocks release blocker #2121. Several of its listed prerequisites (#2251–#2255) may now be satisfied by recently merged composition/typed-session work — worth verifying.
 [...] This is the thing standing between "refactor done" and "migrate existing apps." It demands a clean-room developer build a small app in ≤2h from published docs alone, using only the new model. It's now unblocked, **but its body lists its own pre-execution blockers that aren't cleared yet:** [...] Those doc/scaffold cleanups are the immediate, concrete work before the proof can even run. Once #2256 passes, #2121 drops onboarding/DX as a release blocker — that's the green light for app migration.
 [...] **The refactor is structurally done.** Critical path to migrating existing apps collapses to a single item: **finish #2256's doc cleanup → run the clean-room proof.** Pass that, and #2121 drops onboarding/DX as a release blocker — that's the migration green light. M14 (UniFFI) and #2408 (app-owned kinds) ride separately, post-v1.
